Vacancy for Dr Sushila Nayar Hospital, Utavali
Thursday, 06 November 2025
2322 Hits
The Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS) invites applications for the following posts for Dr. Sushila Nayar Hospital, Utavali, Dharni
(Available Here)
a 50 beded Mother & Child Hospital in Tribal area of Dharni, Melghat) with the prescribed proforma () along with the certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates should reach to the office of:
The Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS), 442102
latest by 25/11/2025.
Gynaecologist-1
Paediatrician-1
Anaesthesiologist-1
Assistant Professor-1 (Community Medicine)
General Duty Medical Officer-1
Required Qualification:
1 to 3: MBBS with NMC recognized Post-graduate Degree/Diploma in concerned subject.
For 4: MBBS with NMC recognized Post-Graduate Degree in concerned Subject and experience as per NMC & MUHS norms
For 5: MBBS/BAMS with 3-5 years experience in a Hospital.
Candidates with previous experience of working in Hospital-Out patient, Inpatient departments and Community Health Services will be preferred.
Salary:
As per Rules of Kasturba Health Society.
Age Limit
: Between 18-38 years for open category/ between 18-43 years for reserved category. Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in age limit. Superannuated person may also be considered upto the age of 65 years for the post 1 to 3.
SECRETARY
Massive Cleanliness Drive Conducted Along Sevagram...
